Shared Spaces

Common Areas

Our common areas are designed for gathering, relaxing, and making memories together — whether you’re sharing a meal, singing the night away, or simply taking in the sound of the sea.

Entertainment Area

Unwind and have fun in our open-air entertainment area, complete with a KTV setup for guests. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply looking for a fun evening with your group, this space is yours to enjoy.

  • KTV System
  • Open-air Setting
  • Shared for All Guests

Dining Area

Our covered dining area sits steps from the shoreline, offering a relaxed space to share meals with family and friends. Enjoy the sea breeze while you dine — tables and seating are available for all guests throughout the day.

  • Covered, Open-air Space
  • Tables & Seating for Groups
  • Available All Day

Kitchen with Chiller & Freezer

A shared kitchen area equipped with a chiller and freezer, available for guests to store and prepare their own food and drinks. Keep your refreshments cold and your group well-fed throughout your stay.

  • Chiller & Freezer Access
  • Shared Kitchen Space
  • Available for All Guests

Comfort Rooms

Clean and well-maintained comfort rooms are available for all guests. Freshening up after a day on the beach has never been more convenient — because the little things matter just as much as the big ones.

  • 2 Toilets with Shower
  • 1 Dedicated Shower Room
  • Shared for All Guests
Out in the Open

Outdoor Spaces

Step outside and let the island do the rest — the beach, the breeze, and the sky are all part of the experience.

Private Beach

Step directly onto the sand from the resort. A quiet stretch of shore exclusively for guests — swim, wade, or simply sit and listen to the waves.

Beach Volleyball Court

A regulation net set up right on the sand. Drop in for a casual game or organise a group match — complimentary for all guests.

Sunset Viewing

Unobstructed western horizon views make every evening a front-row seat to the sky — no ticket required.
